goal: The cutover turns a project's nested Managers on with no lost mail: the dry run changes nothing; apply registers every nested Manager with a mail cursor before flipping the switch, hands each one its running Operators and the root's unread mail about its beads (listed, never moved or marked read) and tells the root; afterwards a running Operator's report to the root lands at its nested Manager; undo flips back, tells the root what returns to it and each nested Manager to stop, and an Operator still naming its nested Manager reports to the root again.

root_inbox.subject: Report on demo-s
root_inbox.body: the step demo-s needs a look
